meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会带你给某个渠道创建第一个 NanoClaw agent：确认你在该渠道的用户身份、新建或复用 agent 分组、把 DM 会话接上，并经由正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信。整个过程可重复运行。
howto.when: 在渠道凭证已配置、服务已在运行、目标渠道适配器已连接之后使用；这些前提不满足时会先让你去跑 /setup。

say.text: 帮我给 Discord 渠道建第一个 agent，我的用户 id 是 xxx
say.note: 会运行初始化脚本，并把欢迎私信排进投递队列

say.text: 我已经用自己账号给 bot 发了条私信，回 done
say.note: 据此查最近的私信分组，确定你的 platform_id
确认端到端投递成功，流程结束

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent for a channel: resolving your channel identity, wiring the DM session to a new or existing agent group, and sending you a welcome DM through the normal delivery path.
howto.when_en: Use it after channel credentials are configured, the service is running, and the target channel adapter is connected; otherwise run /setup first.

say_en.text: Create the first agent for my Discord channel; my user id is xxx
say_en.note: Runs the init script and queues a welcome DM

say_en.text: I've sent the bot a DM from my account — done
say_en.note: Looks up recent DM groups to resolve your platform_id
Confirms end-to-end delivery; skill is done
